item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q019_stable_periodic_release_semantics","answer":"The current-release endpoint reports SCOPe 2.08, labeled 2.08-stable, released September 22, 2021, with a freeze date of July 28, 2021. Its latest periodic update is 2.08-2026-08-16, dated August 16, 2026. For reproducibility, cite 2.08-stable when using the stable snapshot, or the exact dated identifier 2.08-2026-08-16 when using that periodic update; avoid citing only “current” or “latest.” The periodic label identifies a dated update within the 2.08 release series, not a new stable release or evidence of comprehensive manual reclassification. It does not by itself strengthen homology or functional assignments.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info","/api/v1/releases/current"]}]}
